title: Kennel medicine left by the owner
naturalLanguageRequirements: An owner leaves a pet at a kennel overnight and may leave a packet of medicine with the staff. The source text does not say whether the staff give that medicine.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Board a pet

An owner leaves a pet overnight. A packet of medicine may be left with the staff. Whether the staff give that medicine is not stated.

# Data Resources

## Stay

The stay records the pet, the owner, and the night.

# Constraints

## Recorded stay

A boarded pet has one open stay.
